heathrow_express.name: Heathrow Express
heathrow_express.route: Heathrow Central (T2/T3) and T5 to London Paddington
heathrow_express.journey_time: 15 minutes from T2/T3 to Paddington; 21 minutes from T5
heathrow_express.frequency: Every 15 minutes during the day (~05:00 to 23:30)

fares_gbp.express_advance: From £22 if booked the day before or earlier

heathrow_express.tickets: Buy at heathrowexpress.com, on the platform, via the app, or by tapping a contactless card at the gate.
tips: T4 passengers transfer free to Heathrow Central via the Elizabeth line or shuttle.
Children 15 and under travel free with a paying adult.
Tap-in / tap-out with contactless is fastest if you're not booking in advance.

elizabeth_line.name: Elizabeth line
elizabeth_line.route: All Heathrow terminals to London Paddington, central London (Bond Street, Tottenham Court Road, Liverpool Street), Canary Wharf, and east to Abbey Wood / Shenfield
elizabeth_line.journey_time: Around 30 minutes from Heathrow to Paddington; 40 minutes to central London (Bond Street)
elizabeth_line.tickets: Tap a contactless / Apple Pay / Google Pay card at the gates — same Oyster pay-as-you-go system. No need to buy a ticket in advance.
tips: Cheapest mainline option from Heathrow to central London.
Direct to multiple central London stops — no change at Paddington.
Last train varies by line — typically around midnight.

piccadilly_line.name: Piccadilly line (London Underground)
piccadilly_line.route: All Heathrow terminals to central London via South Kensington, Knightsbridge, Hyde Park Corner, Piccadilly Circus, Leicester Square, Covent Garden, Holborn, King's Cross
piccadilly_line.journey_time: Around 50-55 minutes Heathrow to central London (Piccadilly Circus)
piccadilly_line.tickets: Tap a contactless card / Apple Pay / Google Pay at the gates. No paper ticket needed.
tips: Direct service to many central London stops with no change.
Check live status — Piccadilly line has periodic strikes and engineering works.

comparison: **Fastest / most expensive:** Heathrow Express (15 min to Paddington, £25-32 walk-up). **Best value:** Elizabeth line (~30 min, ~£13). **Cheapest:** Piccadilly line (~55 min, ~£6).
